name: The Sacred Flame
summary: From Ashenvale, a phial of moonwell water travels south to Freewind Post. Rau Cliffrunner needs it to break the eternal flame guarding an ancient centaur relic in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Long Journey South
sections.body: Zangen Stonehoof sends you south across central Kalimdor with an etched phial filled with purified moonwell water. You cross the sun-baked expanse of the Barrens, descend the towering Great Lift, and make for Freewind Post. Rau Cliffrunner waits on the high mesa above the canyon floor, watching the centaur clans below.

sections.title: Shared Blood and Ancient Wards
sections.body: Rau Cliffrunner explains why the moonwell water matters to his fight against the centaur. Dryads and centaur share ancestry through Cenarius, whose son Zaetar fathered the centaur. That kinship gives sacred moonwell water an arcane resonance, the one power that can pierce the eternal flame shielding a guarded centaur artifact.

faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner lives atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Travel south through the Barrens, descend the Great Lift to the canyon floor, then follow the southeastern trail to the elevator high on the sheer mesa needle.

faq.q: Why does Rau need moonwell water to combat centaur?
faq.answer: Centaur and dryads share a lineage through Cenarius. Their kinship gives night elf moonwell water the magical harmony needed to break the eternal flame protecting the centaur relic.

faq.q: Who sent me with the phial?
faq.answer: Zangen Stonehoof sent you with the Filled Etched Phial after you gathered water from the guarded moonwell in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happens after giving the phial to Rau?
faq.answer: After Rau confirms the waters are intact, he asks you to use the phial to quench the flame and retrieve the centaur relic from the nearby canyon.

faq.q: How do I get down into Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: Follow the main southern road through the Barrens to the cliff edge. The Great Lift waits there: two wooden elevators operated by tauren pulleys that carry travelers down to the canyon floor.

faq.q: Why are the tauren seeking a centaur relic?
faq.answer: The tauren and centaur have fought a brutal war across Kalimdor for generations. The tauren disrupt centaur rites and seize sacred artifacts to weaken the warlike clans entrenched across the Thousand Needles canyon.

angles.text: Every blow against the centaur helps protect Mulgore and the newly secured borders of your homeland.
Rau Cliffrunner draws on deep knowledge of Cenarion bloodlines to understand the magical resonance between dryads and centaur.
Delivering this phial strengthens Freewind Post, the Horde's high outpost among the perilous passes of Thousand Needles.
